style_lock.serigraphie: Screenprint gig-poster illustration: coarse halftone dots, flat ink shapes, two or three spot colors only, cream or bone paper grain, graphic illustration. Face hidden: back of the head, brim, or crop, no readable nose mouth or eyes. Quiet background: paper plus one or two flat color fields or a geometric stage block. Never a national flag: no blue band over a yellow band (Ukraine), no red-and-yellow horizontal stripes (Spain). Prefer one rectangle plus a circle, or blocks at right angles, not two parallel flag stripes. No sunburst, no starburst, no explosion rays, no speed lines, no radiating beams, no comic-book blast
style_lock.contrejour: Painted silhouette concert illustration: the whole figure is a solid dark cut-out against one dusty halo of stage light, atmospheric haze, profile, zero facial features, painterly grain, illustrated not photographed
style_lock.encre: Expressive ink-wash concert illustration on visible pale paper, not a black void: wet splatters, assembled brush strokes, restricted palette, a shaft of light from above. Face hidden by crop, back view, hat, or instrument — never by a curtain of long wet hair. Hair and headgear must vary. Never a bald or shaved scalp. No readable features. Do not default to crimson or to a crushed-black background

instrument_lock.voix: Singer only: one microphone, handheld or on a stand. Empty hands except the mic. No guitar, no bass, no strap, no second instrument.
instrument_lock.guitare: ONE electric guitar. From behind: LEFT arm IN FRONT of the torso, left HAND on the fretboard, left elbow hidden. RIGHT (strumming) arm hangs along the ribs, elbow TUCKED close to the hip, never a sharp 90-degree elbow sticking out as a triangle. No elbows jutting off the back. If an amplifier is in frame: plain blank cabinet and grille cloth, no logo, no script, no brand name, no Fender, no Marshall, no letters, no numbers.
instrument_lock.basse: Electric four-string Precision bass: four thick strings on a long-scale neck. If the headstock is in frame it must be a 2+2 clover (two tuners left, two right). Prefer the headstock cropped or lost in the halo so tuners are not countable. Never a 4-in-line Jazz headstock with three visible pegs. Not a guitar. From behind: LEFT arm IN FRONT of the torso, left HAND on the neck, left elbow hidden. RIGHT arm hangs along the ribs, elbow TUCKED, never a sharp 90-degree elbow sticking out.
instrument_lock.batterie: Drummer seated on a round drum throne IN the kit, jacket with coarse halftone volume, not a flat pictogram. Two sticks only, one in each hand: right hand hitting, left hand on the snare with the stick held normally, never a third stick, never a stick growing out of the wrist. Full kit: snare, rack toms, floor tom standing on THREE LEGS on the floor (never floating in empty space), kick under the toms, crash on a stand, and a charleston / hi-hat ALWAYS visible (two stacked cymbals on a pedal stand by the left foot). Cymbals stay beside the head on stands. Never a cymbal covering the face or mouth. Never both arms raised in a V. Never a cymbal worn as a hat. Never sitting on the bass drum. Never standing. Never a lone snare. Never a kit without the charleston.
instrument_lock.claviers: Keyboard, piano or organ clearly in frame. BOTH hands on the keys, empty palms. Never holding a hat, cup, box or any object. No guitar.
instrument_lock.vents: Alto saxophone in realistic concert scale. LEFT hand on the UPPER keys near the neck. RIGHT hand in the MIDDLE of the sax body, fingers on the pearl keys, well ABOVE the bow. The flared bell is below both hands, empty, untouched. Never a hand on the bell, never a hand on the bow, never holding the sax like a bottle.
instrument_lock.machines: DJ at the mixer in three-quarter BACK: we see a real head, nape and ear, mixer in front of the torso, hands on the knobs. Never a blank erased face. Never hair poking out of a hood. Never a mask or balaclava. Mixer and decks ON a table with legs. Never a full rear view with the table as a barrier. Nothing floating. No guitar, no bass, no strap.

flux_tail: Trading-card illustration, graphic, emotional. Adult musician, adult body. Never a child. Hide the face by turning away or by a brim, do not erase it into a blank mask. No text, no letters, no logo, no brand name, not a photograph, not anime, not a portrait.
